Package qupath.ext.omero.core

Class Client

java.lang.Object
qupath.ext.omero.core.Client
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class Client extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A class representing a connection to an OMERO web server.

A client can be connected to a server without being authenticated if the server allows it.

One client corresponds to one user, which means a new client must be created to switch user. However, it is not allowed to have two different connections to the same server at the same time.

It has a reference to a ApisHandler which can be used to retrieve information from the OMERO server, and a reference to a Server which is the ancestor of all OMERO entities.

A client must be closed once no longer used.

This class is thread-safe.

  • Method Details

    • createOrGet

      public static Client createOrGet(String url, Credentials credentials, Consumer<Client> onPingFailed) throws URISyntaxException, ExecutionException, InterruptedException
      Create or get a connection to the provided server:
      • If no connection with the provided server exists, a new one is created.
      • If a connection with the provided server exists and the connected user match the provided one in the credentials, the existing connection is returned.
      • If a connection with the provided server exists and the connected user doesn't match the provided one in the credentials, the existing connection is closed and a new one is created.
      This will send a few requests to get basic information on the server and authenticate if necessary, so it can take a few seconds. However, this operation is cancellable.
      Parameters:
      url - the URL to the OMERO web server to connect to. It will be passed to getServerURI(URI) before being processed
      credentials - the credentials to use for the authentication
      onPingFailed - a function that will be called after a ping fails. In that situation, the connection to the server will automatically be closed, so this parameter allows to display some information to the user. This function may be called from any thread. Can be null
      Returns:
      a connection to the provided server
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException - if a link to the server cannot be created
      NullPointerException - if the provided URL doesn't contain a scheme or authority, of if the server doesn't return all necessary information
      ExecutionException - if a request to the server fails or if a response does not contain expected elements. This can happen if the server is unreachable or if the authentication fails for example
      InterruptedException - if the running thread is interrupted
      IllegalArgumentException - if the server doesn't return all necessary information on it, or if the root account was used to log in

    • getServerURI

      public static URI getServerURI(URI uri) throws URISyntaxException
      Create a new URI by removing parts of the provided URI so that it links to the base URL of an OMERO server.

      More precisely:

      • The scheme and the authority of the provided URI are kept.
      • Only part of the path of the provided URI before the "webclient", "webgateway", "iviewer", and "api" path segments is kept.
      • The query and the fragment of the provided URI are discarded.
      Parameters:
      uri - a URI pointing to a link of an OMERO server
      Returns:
      a new URI by removing parts of the provided URI so that it links to the base URL of an OMERO server
      Throws:
      URISyntaxException - if the new URI cannot be created
      NullPointerException - if the provided URI doesn't have a scheme or authority

    • getOpenedImagesURIs

      public javafx.collections.ObservableSet<URI> getOpenedImagesURIs()
      Returns a set of image URIs of this server which have been opened in this session. This class does not automatically detect if new images are opened, so this function actually only returns the URIs given to addOpenedImage.

      This function returns an unmodifiable list, use addOpenedImage or removeOpenedImage(URI) to update its state.

      This set may be updated from any thread.

      Returns:
      a set of image URIs
